name: Combate Global
description: Combate Global (previously Combate Americas) is an American mixed martial arts sports franchise and media company.

videos.title: Gavidia vs. Vazquez
videos.overview: In the 2023 return of Combate, Justin Vazquez (9-2-0) headlines the card in a featherweight matchup against four-time Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu national champion, Alejandro Gavidia.

videos.title: Matuz vs. Pace
videos.overview: Three featured matchups are showcased at Friday's card in Miami, with a welterweight matchup between Jose Matuz and Jimbo Slice set to cap off the evening.

videos.title: Greyson vs. Dayron
videos.overview: A pair of bantamweights headline Saturday's card, with Nathan "Violent Money" Greyson (6-4) taking on the undefeated "El Cazador" Lazaro Dayron (5-0).

videos.title: Ibarra vs. Davila
videos.overview: Ernesto "Stallion" Ibarra looks to bring his pro record to 8-1 in Saturday's flyweight main event against Martin "The Last Inca" Davilla (7-4).

videos.title: Bojorquez vs. Medina
videos.overview: Welterweights take center stage Saturday in Miami, where Ovidio Bojorquez (4-1) squares off against Georgie "Lionheart" Medina (2-1) in the main event.

videos.title: Mexico vs. Japon
videos.overview: Saturday's main event in Miami features a featherweight matchup between Nico Barna (7-2-0) and the undefeated Ramiro "El Cachanilla" Jimenez (6-0-0).

videos.title: World Title Fight
videos.overview: The bantamweight world title is on the line Sunday when Jose "The Mercenary" Zarauz (23-9-1) takes on David "The Black Spartan" Martinez (9-1-0).

videos.title: Gomez vs. Somers
videos.overview: Combate is back Sunday in Miami, where streaking lightweight Cristian "Puas" Perez (11-1-0) takes on Bruno "Aquiles" Cannetti (10-6-0) in the main event.

videos.title: Mateo vs. Rodriguez
videos.overview: Saturday's main even spotlights a pair of welterweights, as Boris Garcia (2-1-0) will be taking on Miami's own Jimmie "Jimbo Slice" Pace (2-0-0).

videos.title: Briseño vs. Ureña
videos.overview: A bantamweight main event showdown between Mexican star Carlos Briseño (14-3) and two-time Dominican Republic national champion Micaias “The Pink Ranger” Ureña (8-3) takes center stage Saturday night.

videos.title: El Showdown
videos.overview: Mexico and USA go to battle Sunday in Miami, where Roberto Romero (6-2-1) takes on Justin Vazquez (10-2-0) in a featherweight main event.

videos.title: Mexico vs. Spain
videos.overview: Sunday's Combate card showcases Silvia Juaneda and Lucero Acosta in the main event, plus a bonus featured bout between Matias Palma and Tony Cortez.

videos.title: Castillo vs. Guzman
videos.overview: Lightweights take center stage in Miami, where Ivan Castillo (22-17) looks to snap a losing streak against "The Scorpion King" Santiago Guzman (7-3).

videos.title: Perez vs. Eguiluz
videos.overview: Sporting a 4-1 record in his last five Combate fights, Jair "Lupe" Perez (8-3) takes on Mauricio Equiliz (10-6-1) in Saturday's featherweight main event.

videos.title: Ferreira vs. Morales
videos.overview: Featherweights headline Saturday's event in Miami, where Jose Ferreira (11-0) puts his undefeated record on the line against Leonardo Morales (12-7).

videos.title: El Grito de Mexico
videos.overview: Miami native Loxbey Montalvan looks to stay unbeaten as a professional when he takes on Ivan Nunez Miranda in Saturday's bantamweight main event.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: A battle of unbeaten welterweights takes place Saturday in Miami, where Christopher "El Tanque" Ewert takes on Jimmie "Jimbo Slice" Pace in the main event.

videos.title: Beltran vs. Jagel
videos.overview: Saturday's main event features a pair of relative newcomers, as Anthony "The Bagel" Jagel (0-0) takes on Henry Beltran (1-0) in a flyweight bout.

videos.title: Blair vs. Pantro
videos.overview: Colombia native Javier "Blair" Reyes (16-3) puts a six-fight winning streak on the line when he takes on Stiven "Pantro" Valencia in Friday's main event.

videos.title: Puas vs. Piedrahita
videos.overview: Combate is back in Miami on Saturday, where Sebastian "Pitbull" Piedrahita (11-4-0) takes on Cristian "Puas" Perez (12-1-0) in a lightweight main event.

videos.title: Sanchez vs. Kallionidou
videos.overview: Maritza Sanchez puts a five-fight winning streak on the line in Saturday's main event, taking on Elina "Gunner" Kallionidou in a women's flyweight bout.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Four Copa Combate featherweight quarterfinal bouts will take place Friday in Miami, concluding with a showdown between Nicholas Barna and Leonardo Morales.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: A Copa Combate featherweight champion will be crowned at the conclusion of Saturday's card, which includes both the semifinals and championship fight.

videos.title: Ireland vs. Mexico
videos.overview: Undefeated in seven Combate appearances, Roberto "El Charro Negro" Romero takes on Partrick "The Leech" Lehane in Sunday's featherweight main event.
